title: Stepped band wave wipes open to a typed intro card
summary: Thick accent bands stepped like a bar graph swell across a light grid, split and slide off top and bottom, uncovering a white card where an eyebrow word types with a block caret, then the name and an accent product line type in.
use_when: a 3 s brand sting before a product demo
announcing a named product or dataset with one accent phrase
a light, technical brand with one strong accent colour

look.type_style: medium grotesk, sentence case, tight tracking, ~8 % of frame height, block underscore caret; second line: name in fg + product phrase in accent

sfx.event: bands split and slide off the frame

structure.shot: accent bands stepped in ~10 columns, tallest at left, tapering right like a wave, over a light square grid with sparse character speckle on band edges
structure.camera: static frame; the bands carry the motion (bands rise ~71 px/s and tilt slightly, motion.json)
structure.motion: 0.00 one band at upper third; 0.27 and 0.50 band thickens toward a peak (easings.outCubic ~15 fr, suggested); 0.77 it splits into a top and a bottom band opening a gap at centre (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: bands retreat to top and bottom edges and leave; a white chip at centre grows into a large white card with corner handles and guide lines while an eyebrow word types
structure.camera: card scale grows ~13 %/s (motion.json); chip ~25 % W at 1.00 to ~83 % W at 1.77
structure.motion: bands slide out vertically, gone by 1.50 (mask-wipe 0.77 to 1.30, cuts.json soft); card grows springs.layout ~22 fr (overshoot not measurable); typewriter ~12 chars/s = 2.5 fr per char (2, 5, 7, 10 chars at 1.00/1.27/1.50/1.77), block caret

structure.shot: eyebrow cleared; on the full card a product name in fg types followed by a 2-word product phrase in accent, centred
structure.motion: word cleared in one cell at 2.00; line typed fast with a soft fading leading edge, ~17 of ~25 chars at 2.27, complete at 2.50 (~45 chars/s, ±0.25 s); holds ~7 fr

params.eyebrow: one announcing word typed first, ≤ 12 chars
params.name: product or company name, fg colour, ≤ 12 chars

notes: One-shot film: zero hard cuts, one soft transition 0.77 to 1.30 s (the band split-and-slide wipe). Measured at 0.25 s from sheet-01 and two keyframes: typing cadence ~2.5 fr per char for the eyebrow; second line much faster. Spring and easing names are suggested (overshoot not measurable). The row split at 2.00 is a visible state change, not a cut. Silent reference: all SFX planned by the glue rule, not measured. Proposed terms (not used as ids): stepped-band-wave, guide-frame-card, char-speckle.
